'''Jalen Palladane''' was the infant son of the covert [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gorlan Palladane]] and [[Roah Palladane]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Chelloa]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He was the younger brother of [[Aneese Palladane]], and their family lived in the mining colony of [[Jenith]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], his parents sheltered the female Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]], the last surviving member of the ill-fated [[Operation Influx]]. Following the arrest of his father by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], Daiman's forces plundered and murdered the inhabitants of Jenith. During the crackdown, the Palladane home was invaded by a pair of [[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|Sith troopers]]. However, the Palladanes were rescued by Holt, who slew the two home invaders.
